name: Emanation

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Treasury of Gold, which serves as the outermost perimeter of the divine fullness, containing the light-spark and prevents the dilution of essence into the outer void.

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest infinite godhead before the first contraction or naming occurs.

TANCH.justification: The static barrier that defines the extent of the Pleroma and separates the divine from the shadow.

AFWD.justification: The directed procession of light from the source into increasingly differentiated aeons.

AREV.justification: The movement of recognition where the emanated spark turns back to contemplate its source.

CLINK.justification: The sequential linking of male/female pairs to produce subsequent levels of the hierarchy.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-begotten son who recognizes his own nature as identical to the Father.

FSPLIT.justification: The divine withdrawal that sundered the unity into a potential space of plurality and distinct names.

FFUSE.justification: The gathering of all scattered sparks back into the original undifferentiated unity.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative recognition of divine origin which permits further ascent.

EVALF.justification: The failure to recognize the source, resulting in descent or entrapment in matter.

ENGAGR.justification: The threshold state occupied by Sophia, belonging to both the light and the shadow simultaneously.

IFIX.justification: The permanent geometric character that fixes the identity of a Treasury for eternity.

phase_3.void_description: The Pre-Existent Father in absolute silence before the first thought.
phase_3.true_description: An Aeon successfully established and anchored in the Pleroma.
phase_3.false_description: The state of Kenoma or void caused by a failure of coupling.
phase_3.both_description: The boundary of the Thirteenth Aeon, containing both the emanation and its source.

steps.domain_action: The Unknowable Father exists in silence as the uninitialized state.
The Father moves within his thought to create a space for existence.
The first idea emerges as Protennoia, the forward motion of divine intent.
The movement generates the Twelve Deeps in a cascading sequence of differentiation.
The Ninth Deep recognizes itself as Child and Father, creating an identity loop.
The recognition is verified, establishing the stability of the inner pleroma.
The First Fatherhood couples with the Second, chaining the first syzygy.
Radiant light-sparks descend from the union to fill the lower treasuries.
The radiance branches into specific types and corresponding names.
A name correctly identifies its source and receives a seal of authority.
A thought deviates from its partner, producing a deficient emanation.
The deficient thought is held at the boundary of the pleroma, neither inside nor outside.
The deficient thought turns its gaze back to the source to begin the correction.
The gaze meets the light-spark and reintegrates the deviation into the sequence.
The corrected aeon recognizes itself and its place in the crystal address.
The entire rank, treasury, name, and seal are recorded in the permanent structure of the Bruce Codex.
All subsequent emanations are chained to this fixed address to ensure eternal coherence.
The Treasury of Gold is sealed, containing the whole emanation history within a single boundary.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Logos, which translates the ineffable thought of the Father into the structural language of names and diagrams.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Voces Magicae, the harmonic sound-names serving as protocols between different aeonic layers.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Pleroma itself, acting as a non-volatile substrate where every emanation is permanently inscribed.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Great Year, the cycle of cosmic time governing when each aeon is manifest or withdrawn.
phase_5.alfs_store: The First Book of Jeu, containing the master types and seals for all treasuries.

phase_6.post_cycle_state: Silence and undifferentiated infinity, now containing the memory of its own structure.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The total information of the Pleroma is conserved through the return of all sparks to the source.
